entities.summary: Suzana Tratnik (b. 1963-04-20, Murska Sobota) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Murska Sobota and Slovenia. Known in the fields of slovenia, poets & playwrights, europe.
